_note: Client Hub status colours, which Levi's kit does not define. Text colour passes 4.5:1 on the sky ground, the warm white panel and its own tint. Each status is always shown with an icon and a word, never by colour alone. Checked by scripts/check-contrast.mjs. Client type accents live in public/config/client-types.json.
_textNote: Text colours that are not in Levi's kit. placeholder is slate softened to a solid colour that still passes 4.5:1 on the warm white field (opacity is never used to mute text, because the contrast check cannot see it). onAccent is the text on a selected fit pill, a pressed filter chip and the current sub navigation pill.
